extraction_notes: Main-text performance data occur in Figure 1a, 1c, and 1d. Figure 1b was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot. Figures 2–6 are characterization/DFT/schematic figures and were not digitised as NH3 synthesis performance plots. NH3 yield values in Figure 1a and 1d were read from the right axes; rates from the left axes. Conditions not on axes were taken from the Figure 1 caption and the Experimental section on page 2.
